components.text:
Circle: small circle, ritual chalk.

Attunes a Vampire Compass to the owner of a taglock. In its new third mode the needle points at the middle of a square around them, and the tooltip says about how far, in hundreds of blocks.
Only a witch, siphoner, heretic or tribrid can work it. It lasts 30 minutes. The one looked for is told 'Somebody is looking for you', with no name.
The needle spins the same way for every reason it cannot find them: far away, in another dimension, cloaked, away from the game, or the time spent.
